title: [YouPass Collect] - A small museum and its surroundings in 1990 and 2010.
prompt: The diagrams show a small museum and its surroundings in 1990 and 2010. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The diagrams illustrate the layout of a small museum and its surrounding area in 1990 and the changes that occurred by 2010.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the museum underwent significant expansion and renovation during this 20-year period. The most notable changes included the replacement of the cottage with a cafe, substantial enlargement of the car park, and the addition of new exhibition space within the main building.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding the main museum building, the internal layout experienced significant modifications between 1990 and 2010. On the left-hand side of the entrance, the two exhibition rooms, which used to be separated by walls, were merged into one by 2010. The shop subsequently expanded considerably by occupying the former exhibition room space, creating a much larger retail area. Meanwhile, the store room in the upper left section and the entrance remained in their original positions and sizes.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: As for the surrounding facilities, the most striking transformation occurred on the southern side of the complex, where the cottage that existed in 1990 was completely replaced by a cafe by 2010. Additionally, the car park experienced dramatic expansion at the expense of a large garden nearby, growing from a small area on the eastern side of the map in 1990 to a much larger facility that extended significantly further south by 2010. The other garden area in the north remained unchanged over the period, still housing a number of green trees.
